name: type-out
title: Type out
description: Type out text character by character instead of pasting — for places where paste is disabled or discouraged
author: M4Marvin

commands.name: type-out
commands.title: Type out Text
commands.description: Types out the given text or your clipboard character by character into the frontmost app

arguments.name: text
arguments.placeholder: Text to type (leave empty to use clipboard)

commands.name: history
commands.title: Type out from History
commands.description: Pick one of your recent clipboard entries and type it out character by character

preferences.name: startDelayMs
preferences.title: Start Delay
preferences.description: Milliseconds to wait before typing starts, so focus settles on the target app

preferences.name: pressReturn
preferences.title: Press Return
preferences.description: Press Return after the text finishes typing
preferences.label: Press Return at the end
